description: This file defines the 'AOW_WorkFlow' class, which manages workflow logic in SuiteCRM, including functions for executing workflows, evaluating conditions, and running associated actions.

classes.name: AOW_WorkFlow
classes.description: Represents a workflow in SuiteCRM, providing methods for executing, evaluating, and managing workflow conditions and actions.

methods.name: getSQLOperator
methods.description: Returns the SQL operator corresponding to a given key.

methods.name: isSQLOperator
methods.description: Checks if a given key is a valid SQL operator.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Constructor method that initializes the workflow object and loads flow beans.

methods.name: bean_implements
methods.description: Indicates if the class implements a specific interface, like 'ACL'.

methods.name: save
methods.description: Saves the workflow object and associated conditions and actions.

methods.name: mark_deleted
methods.description: Marks the workflow and its linked beans as deleted.

methods.name: load_flow_beans
methods.description: Loads module list for workflow modules.

methods.name: run_flows
methods.description: Retrieves and runs all active workflows.

methods.name: run_bean_flows
methods.description: Runs workflows applicable to a specific bean.

methods.name: get_flow_beans
methods.description: Builds a query to retrieve beans matching workflow conditions.

methods.name: build_flow_custom_query_join
methods.description: Builds a custom join for flow queries.

methods.name: build_flow_relationship_query_join
methods.description: Builds a relationship join for flow queries.

methods.name: build_flow_query_where
methods.description: Builds the WHERE clause of a flow query based on conditions.

methods.name: build_query_where
methods.description: Constructs WHERE conditions based on a specific condition object, module, and current query.

methods.name: check_valid_bean
methods.description: Checks if a bean satisfies the workflow's run conditions.

methods.name: compare_condition
methods.description: Compares two values based on a given operator.

methods.name: check_in_group
methods.description: Checks if a bean belongs to a security group.

methods.name: run_actions
methods.description: Executes actions associated with the workflow on a given bean.
